integrity: The all-size statement is proved symbolically. Finite enumeration is used only as an independent regression check and is not treated as evidence for untested sizes.
scientific_limitations: The formula is proved for finite \(T_0\)-spaces capped by an antichain of new maximal points. It does not extend verbatim to arbitrary lexicographic summands and does not itself determine the distribution of \(u(g)\).
title: Exact fixed-point-free map counts under finite antichain caps
